limitationTriage.limitation: Horrocks (2002) had been credited from its abstract only in v0.1.0.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does Horrocks 2002 already contain the ULC form or the proof method?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Owner-supplied full text read in full on 4 November 2026 and compared theorem by theorem.
limitationTriage.resolution: No statement collision: Theorem 2.5 is ordinary log-concavity with a +p_k term and does not imply ULC. Method overlap credited: the pair-partition reduction to doubly dependent counts (Lemma 2.1) is a precursor of this proof's structure.
